{{tocright}}[[File:Undead_Faction_Building.png|thumb|left]]{{Description|"Undead are resilient and tireless, but most importantly, they can't die. Affiliating yourself with the Undead faction will grant you a steady flow of production which increases drastically as time passes."}}  
== The Undead Faction ==
[[File:Undead champion trophy.png|left|54x54px|Undead Champion Trophy]]
[[File:True_Night.png|right|True Night]]
Part of the original Evil [[Vanilla Factions]], the '''Undead''' become more powerful with time. Their Heritage and Bloodline give [[assistants]] based on playtime and reincarnations is more frequently used in late games.
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Evil'''''
* '''[[Alignment#Leges|Leges]]''': '''''Order'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Night Time''''' - The production of assistants is increased by 30% based on the amount of Necropolises you own for 20 seconds.  
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''':'''''True Night''''' - Increases ''Night Time''<nowiki/>'s production of assistants to 40% per Necropolis.   
** Unlock requirement: Cast the ''Night Time'' spell after 11 pm and before 6 am.  
* '''[[Heritage]]''':  You gain additional assistants based on the time spent in this game.<br />{{Formula|floor(1 + 1.5 * x^{0.5})|your Playtime (This Game) stat in hours}}
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Gain additional assistants based on the amount of times you [[Reincarnate|reincarnated]].<br />{{Formula|floor(8 * x^{0.8})|the number of times you have reincarnated}}  
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''':  '''''Midnight Time''''' - Increase Night Time assistant bonus based on [[Stats|total time]] spent [[offline]].<br />{{Formula|0.2 \times x^{0.7}%|your Time Spent Offline (Total) stat in seconds}}  
* '''[[Unique Buldings|Research Building]]''':  '''''Undercities''''' (from Necropolis)
* '''[[Research|Research Facility]]''': '''''Alchemy'''''  
* '''[[Buildings#Leges Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''':  '''''Flesh Workshops''''' (from Orcish Arenas)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': None (All Vanilla Factions are enabled by default)

== Unique Buildings ==
[[File:Undead_Unique_Building_Design.png|thumb|left]]
[[File:Special-building-undead.png|right]] 
[[File:Flesh Workshop.png|right]] 
At R16, the Undead's  ''Necropolis'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]] called '''''Undercity''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests. 

At R100, the Undead's ''Orcish Arenas'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Flesh Workshops''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.{{Clr}}

== Undead Research ==
[[File:Research-new-progress-system-msg.PNG|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R16, the game advisor tells us that the Vanilla factions have gained tremendous power. Their power can be ours if we get ready and seek them again. 

To unlock Undead research, play the Undead faction and simply follow the appearing quests (Do not [[prestige]]). These can be done in separate game plays.
